com.empline/tool-documentation.access: Requires OAuth store:read consent. The connected account must own an approved store.
com.empline/tool-documentation.effects: Read-only; no quantities are reserved or changed.
com.empline/tool-documentation.failures: An account without an approved store receives a tool error; an empty store returns zero counts.
com.empline/tool-documentation.notFor: Per-card prices, sales orders and stock adjustments are outside this summary.
com.empline/tool-documentation.purpose: Summarize the connected seller's store inventory; no arguments are needed.
com.empline/tool-documentation.returns: Returns counts by listing status, totalListings, totalQuantity and totalQuantityAvailable for the owned store.
com.empline/tool-documentation.useWhen: Use for an aggregate stock overview rather than individual listing details.
